structured.feedback: The description is about 190 words in Markdown with clear subheadings, an active voice and a call to action. It leaves out the icing, wrinkle and pore complaints, links and invented quotes. Minor flaws are the loose feature/benefit split, "certified vegan" (the listing only says "vegan"), and "many customers" (only one review says this).
